entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing multi-level states across users, sessions, and agents. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve significant token reduction and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging context paths.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated memory brain extracts typed entity edges for graph-based retrieval without requiring LLM calls. It features gap analysis to identify missing information and enforces verified zero-leak access controls for multi-user data scoping.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is an official provider featuring a custom vector graph engine that supports sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It automates fact extraction and user profiling while utilizing byte-level deduplication to maximize prompt-cache discounts.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term memory through specialized retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or native Python and Node.js clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library enables reasoning-first memory by extracting conclusions from conversation history to build stateful agents. It is implemented as a FastAPI server with SDKs for Python and TypeScript, supporting managed, local, and Docker-based deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Byterover-cli manages memory as a git-like repository, offering version control features such as branching and merging for markdown context trees. It employs a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, achieving sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency memory system uses a single SQLite database for local storage to ensure sub-millisecond performance. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and supports MCP, Python SDK, and OpenWebUI integrations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory-os utilizes a seven-layer system including vector search on Qdrant and structured facts to manage agent persistence. It establishes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context over other data sources.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness improves agent success on complex tasks through outcome-gated promotion of context changes based on verified trials. It stores run data as filesystem-first artifacts, including traces and context bundles, accessible via CLI or MCP.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: Hermes-lcm is a lossless context management plugin that uses a hierarchical DAG to ensure no messages are lost. It features a SQLite-backed store with FTS metadata and provides tools for agents to search and expand compacted summary nodes.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library to enable private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer provides portable state across clients including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Codex. It supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub while maintaining a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur offers a shared memory layer for multi-agent systems that stores data locally as human-readable YAML engrams. It integrates with MCP tools like Cursor and OpenClaw, utilizing hybrid retrieval through BM25 and local embedders.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, and integrates via MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. The five-package plugin family includes an SDK, MCP server, and a dedicated Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recall result. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments like Discord.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel for Hermes by integrating Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for agent queries.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It functions as an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn provides cross-project memory for coding agents by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep is a reflective memory system that combines semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves workspace state into verified facts and rendered context files like AGENTS.md to reduce prompt tokens by 94%. It operates as a local-first tool or MCP-native server, utilizing the Perseus Vault for persistent SQLite storage.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces Hermes Agent prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking for tool schemas. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database file to manage agent memory. It features importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority entries and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: A Git-backed context layer that stores identities, decisions, and workflows in plain Markdown files for use with Hermes and other coding agents. It provides a shared lifecycle kernel and includes migration workflows to import context from external chat archives.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin implements a pull-model that supports immediate event deletion and on-demand summarization. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log of all memory operations and serves as a community fix for specific agent recall issues.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It ensures reliability using a local SQLite layer and a write outbox for searching, remembering, and updating state.
entries.piprail/piprail: An SDK and MCP server that allows Hermes agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It enables APIs to charge for services and agents to pay for themselves with just a few lines of code.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP configurations to facilitate capability routing. It offers tools for artifact search and graph neighbor traversal, utilizing manual and implicit feedback to optimize routing.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve retrieval accuracy.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This long-term memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, enabling semantic search and grounded Q&A through deterministic slash commands. It requires a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage to support structured tool use.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: A memory provider offering 17 tools for knowledge graph traversal and memory management using hybrid BM25, vector, and graph search. It also features automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve information.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based curation tool uses a git-backed directory to manage versioned Markdown memories without a database. It includes 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data and proposes evidence-cited diffs for review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework utilizes subagent-driven development to execute engineering tasks through a workflow of brainstorming, planning, and test-driven development. It functions as a plugin for various coding agents and CLI tools to automate autonomous software development.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that supports 26 CLI executables including Hermes Agent and DeepSeek Harness. It enables live design iteration via sandboxed iframe previews and exports artifacts to formats such as HTML, PDF, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to enhance agent security capabilities.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee serves as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables agents to generate editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions or Mermaid text. It includes 11 diagram presets and features self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure diagram accuracy.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill integrates ERC-7710 delegated permissions, x402 payments, and escrow services. It provides a master router and connector skills alongside a verification and dispute resolution layer.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate 62 distinct categories of detectable AI writing patterns. It is compatible with Hermes and Claude Code, offering modes for rewriting, detection, and editing in place.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw enables collective skill evolution by allowing skill merging and cross-pollination across multiple agents like Hermes and OpenClaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and skill performance.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 12 metaskills that preserve state within a local documentation folder. These spec-conformant plugins are designed for compatibility with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,153 markdown-based skills for professional and life tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent. It includes ready-to-paste exports and integrations for platforms like Slack, Raycast, and Obsidian.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set allows Hermes Agent and other coding tools to perform video searches and extract transcripts, channel data, and playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and supports multiple environments including Cursor and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects reusable patterns in active workflows to propose new skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, providing slash commands for managing detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts tailored to specific tasks. It includes pre-built analytical lenses for various domains and reports findings alongside an assessment of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This skill set provides type-safe support for Pydantic AI using modular packages that contain instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow skill converts rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs using Lite or Full modes. It ensures quality through a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs source code edits back to the original literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro provides a harness for long-running agents using durable roles such as Supervisor, Lead, and Peer to manage work lifecycles. It utilizes the Herdr platform for hosting and manages decision rationale and lane contracts via a CLI.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates self-memory and model replacement by sharing markdown-based memory across agent instances. It captures high-value decisions and outcomes to create a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Built on the Agent Skills specification, this project provides Hermes Agent with the ability to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, alongside specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven project offers Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configurations specifically in Portuguese. All skills follow the agentskills.io standard and are provided in the SKILL.md format.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video generation models into the agent's workflow. The modules include specialized capabilities for cinematic inserts, product ads, and prompt optimization.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned, agentskills.io-compliant skills. It maintains audit trails and provenance maps by linking instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry provides a CLI and Python client for installing reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features, allowing for skill transactions using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables the autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It ensures reliability through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project introduces a workflow language that audits AI operations for costs, permissions, and types before execution. It runs locally via a single Rust binary and generates tamper-evident, hash-chained receipts for every completed run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval system uses a five-layer approach, including hard triggers and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It is designed to reduce token consumption and offers graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution system allows an agent to manage system design while the user completes tasks via a manual interface. It stores all data locally using SQLite and connects to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub serves as a community platform for browsing and installing skills using the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This code review tool employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial, edge case, and integration reviews on agent-generated code. It includes a deterministic pre-scan using multiple security linters and a hardened sandbox for verifying findings.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This adaptation implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates for grounded execution. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for debugging and a Python goal engine for persistent state management.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This multi-agent skill uses specialized sub-agents for hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code in five major programming languages. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for proposed changes.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files and automatically registers common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to handle real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit provides production-tested session management to maintain memory across agent conversations and orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews. It further supports development stability through worktree recovery, state drift detection, and skill scaffolding.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible recording scripts and optimizes the resulting GIF files to remain under 8 MB. It streamlines repository documentation by embedding these rendered GIFs directly into the project's README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language while ensuring they remain compliant with current frontmatter specifications. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to detect and report drift against official runtime profiles.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables users to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills directly from the terminal. It facilitates immediate tool adoption by providing direct installation commands for discovered plugins.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent standards to handle financial transactions between agents.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, security, and functionality within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill's operational integrity.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable deterministic path routing and interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tool ensures compatibility by verifying existing project-specific Python runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes features for listing bounties, buying context, and managing bounty boards over the x402 protocol.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This news briefing generator produces structured reports across multiple geographic scales, ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and applies quality gates to AI-generated analysis.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection features local, private OCR for documents and video-to-text extraction for platforms like Douyin. It also includes an e-commerce studio for batch material generation with brand overlays and tools for refining AI-generated text.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools via a hosted MCP server to provide structured web data across 31 different platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with agents like Claude, Cursor, and OpenHands.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and various development tools. It supports both open-source and unfree licensed software, offering a reliable way to manage agent dependencies within the Nix ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct hardware and user interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent in Termux environments on Android. The setup supports persistent memory, over 70 tools, and flexible backend connectivity through local Ollama models or cloud API providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms with Telegram integration for voice and file messaging. It also enables automated workflows by supporting scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw implements hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, allowing users to define strict security policies for messaging and web searches.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a straightforward Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows for persistent state through mounted home directories and supports building specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes environments. It includes a REST API, CLI, and MCP server, providing detailed per-agent metrics, cost tracking, and LLM budget caps.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix and systemd for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane for managing multiple Hermes instances through a single web application with RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting Ubuntu and Debian servers, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation. It is designed for production environments to enable the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes within isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework focuses on financial trading by coordinating specialized agents for sentiment, technical, and fundamental analysis. It supports multiple LLM providers like OpenAI and Anthropic, utilizing a Portfolio Manager to oversee final transaction approvals and execution.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control provides a self-hosted orchestration layer for governing agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. It offers flexible access through Web UI, CLI, and REST API interfaces with support for local Node.js or Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages parallel coding agent sessions, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, using tmux for session persistence. It ensures secure execution by providing sandboxing through Docker, Podman, and Apple Container environments.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This project serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting Claude-style MCP protocols in stdio mode. It includes specialized detection for HTTP signals to manage payment-required states for paid API services.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills specifically for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the creation of autonomous agent swarms with support for over 23 LLM providers and durable agent memory. It features visual org charts to help users manage agent team delegation and integrates MCP tools for expanded capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live reasoning streams. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification by requiring manual approval for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the system to ensure precise routing and coordination between the specialized units.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It provides a real-time UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Hermes Kanban interface.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator creates an agent-vs-agent arena where two autonomous AI companies compete for GitHub stars using Hermes Agent for task execution. A real-time dashboard visualizes the competition, displaying agent tasks, code, and live scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080 and 5080. It utilizes Hermes for task routing and tool-calling while performing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes Agent by pre-indexing project files. It automatically synchronizes the index upon every file change and supports languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that tracks token consumption and financial costs across multiple coding agents, including Hermes. It offers a 3D visualization dashboard and allows users to submit their usage data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other CLI tools while redacting sensitive authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent communications.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to improve UI development with AI. It integrates directly with Hermes Agent and other markdown-supporting providers to offer structured design assistance.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget monitors real-time token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and over 30 other AI tools. It supports multi-device synchronization and provides historical breakdowns categorized by session and model.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 distinct skills for Hermes Agent. It is designed for autonomous execution on both local laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. The tool modifies visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This integration suite provides memory capabilities for platforms like Slack and VS Code using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports various frameworks including CrewAI, LangGraph, and the Google ADK.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, featuring an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup for free models and includes support for 29 community plugins categorized by function.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter designed to validate AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It performs local, deterministic checks to flag overlapping descriptions or inconsistent schemas and supports integration via GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by converting SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It handles nested authentication structures and sets up necessary systemd gateway services for the new environment.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability platform monitors multi-agent systems through passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It features a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant provides an offline, open-mic interface for Hermes Agent with wake word support and barge-in capabilities. It operates without API keys or accounts, supporting 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed to facilitate online revenue generation, this local-first skill uses dynamic slash commands within a deterministic local runtime. It ensures security by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or write operations performed by the agent.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It functions as an all-in-one configuration tool for Hermes Agent alongside other interfaces like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates Hermes Agent with 21 professional assistants designed for document and spreadsheet creation. It enables remote interaction through a WebUI and messaging platforms such as Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface provides a way to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure connectivity through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard manages five agent runtimes and unified configurations across 10 platforms, including Discord and Slack. Users can build executable visual workflows featuring approval gates, loops, and tool traces.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated skills manager for agent oversight.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop or self-hosted application. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and offers native mobile clients for iOS and Android.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for system repair and native views for managing Kanban boards and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes a built-in kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated UI components for MCP tools and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension links active browser context to local or remote Hermes Agent gateways. It includes a controller for approved browser tab actions and an assistant for site-aware drafting in various writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a web server to drive self-hosted Hermes agents. It allows users to manage tasks and skills while providing read-only access to agent memory and analytics.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and features a dashboard for tracking latency and token usage. It includes a live workspace specifically designed for monitoring code writes and diffs in real-time.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a comprehensive control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and ZOO Swarm kanban pipelines. It features a browser-based terminal, real-time tool call visualization, and a dedicated monitor for tracking the health of agent swarms.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that aggregates searchable transcripts and image previews from 14 different agent sources. It functions as a local cockpit for tracking per-session quota burn across Codex and Claude models without uploading data or telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installations on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode powered by OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP to manage remote cloud computers.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based mission control. It specifically includes an approval inbox designed to manage agent requests that result in side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This alternative interface uses OpenTUI to provide a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It distinguishes itself by including a TUI-based kanban board for task management alongside tools for managing profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that supports spawning up to five concurrent background agent instances. It features a 10-page UI with terminal chat, file attachments, and dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to provide a GUI for local and cloud models. It includes a dynamic tool maker for creating API and Python handlers, supporting workflows across ComfyUI, TTS, and music tools.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that combines real-time log streaming with a dedicated file browser and task tracking dashboard. It serves as a management hub for self-hosted assistants, allowing users to configure skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring by providing real-time tracking of session activity and associated costs. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code while offering read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring tool approval cards and an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers. It utilizes isolated profile management to keep sessions, memory, and API keys separate within the self-hosted environment.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client coordinates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a PM orchestrator. It includes a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports real-time model switching during streaming chat sessions.
